## Install / Update

Install the `dsh-goal-plus-plus` plugin on [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) with released [NPM package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-goal-plus-plus):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-goal-plus-plus@latest
```

Update the `dsh-goal-plus-plus` plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-goal-plus-plus@latest
```
